items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V3.2 and V3.2-Speciale
items.summary: DeepSeek-V3.2 succeeds V3.2-Exp as the default app and API model and supports tool use in thinking mode; DeepSeek claims GPT-5-level performance. V3.2-Speciale, a higher-compute reasoning variant without tool use, is claimed to reach gold-level results at IMO, CMO, ICPC World Finals and IOI 2025; weights for both are on Hugging Face.
